description: Standalone Morphe patches for Gboard Rambler: Smart Search Bars (auto-strip trailing period + opt-in per-app Auto-Search on commit for Chrome, YouTube, Play Store, Settings & more), Long-press Spacebar for Rambler (Smart Hybrid / Hold-to-Talk / Toggle modes, works with or without Cursor Trackpad), draggable Rambler Toolbar quick-access button, 1-Tap Fix & Learn from Dictation History, Hex by Anomaly waveforms, Per-App Custom Instructions & Behavior Overrides, Productivity Tools (private On-Device Dictation Stats, Voice Send/Search suffixes, Voice Snippets, Find & Replace, Strip Trailing Period, Local Dictation History, Auto Parallel Retry, Longer Dictation Sessions, JSON Backup & Restore), Personal Dictionary (MUSE_STATS), Contact Names, Cursor-Aware & Append-Only Editing, and App Context. Stacks conflict-free alongside upstream GboardWu v4.5.0+. Verified on Gboard 18.5.4 and tested on 18.8.0.
